newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dupont-Denant upgrades rating on Credit Lyonnais.
newsitem.headline: Dupont-Denant upgrades rating on Credit Lyonnais.

text.p: Brokerage Dupont-Denant said it raised its rating on certificates of state bank Credit Lyonnais to C2, or market performer, from C3, or underperformer.
But it advised caution, given the lack of visibility of the bank.

Credit Lyonnais certificates were up 7.07 percent at 199.80 francs at 1410 GMT. The newspaper Les Echos reported on Thursday that its net attributable profit was expected to rise to between 3.4 and 3.7 billion francs in 1997 from around 300 million for 1996.

Credit Lyonnais declined to comment on the report, but an analyst at Dupont-Denant said the figures seems "reasonable to the extent that the U.S. and Asian subsidiaries performed particularly well in the last quarter of the year".
